title: An Introduction to Kairos — Persuasion Beyond Ethos, Logos and Pathos
skills: define kairos as a rhetorical concept
analyze how timing and context influence persuasion
distinguish kairos from ethos, logos, and pathos
evaluate how speakers and writers adapt messages to particular moments and circumstances
alignment_note: Introduces kairos as the rhetorical importance of timing, context, and opportunity in persuasion. Extends study beyond ethos, logos, and pathos and supports rhetorical analysis, audience awareness, contextual reasoning, and strategic communication across high school English courses.
